mean_cn: v.高估；过高评价（读作/ˌoʊvərˈɛstəˌmeɪt/）；  n.过高的估计或评价
mean_en: to estimate something to be larger, better, more important, etc. than it really is
sentence: I think that the baby overestimates his appetite.
sentence_trans: 我觉得这个宝宝高估了自己的食量。
